relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a clinically and biochemically diagnosed Tangier disease patient ("a middle-aged man with Tangier disease"); no ABCA1 genetic testing or variant is reported.
method_note: Read the whole paper and wrote rows with a short Python script from my own reading; no table was transcribed (Table 1 content is absent from the Markdown, only its title). Diagnosis was clinical, biochemical and histopathological; the paper reports no ABCA1 sequencing, so the variants table is empty. The patient is in scope by diagnosis of Tangier disease. Ref [5] ('A similar patient has already been reported by the authors') and the Fredrickson siblings get no rows (no individual-level facts). Durations ('of 4 years duration', 'Over the last 3 years', 'since a year') are recorded as text; no age at onset is stated, so no ISO onset was derived. Normal whole investigations (hemogram, abdominal ultrasound, Doppler of the neck vessels, echocardiography) are recorded as excluded abnormal investigations only, per D-27; they were not used to exclude thrombocytopenia, splenomegaly, hepatomegaly, non-coronary arterial disease or coronary artery disease. Intact kinesthetic sensation was not used to exclude 'reduced deep sensation' (vibration not addressed; narrow vs broad rule). Corneal opacity was marked excluded from the normal slit lamp examination for corneal fat deposits. Tendon reflexes are not mentioned. No history of dysautonomia symptoms and normal conventional autonomic tests sit beside absent sympathetic skin responses; recorded both, not treated as a contradiction. 'No family history of neuropathic illness' concerns relatives and was not recorded as a feature. No contradictions found.
